definition.normal: Independent lexical entries, all comparisons, and irregular inflections. A qualifying independent sense or irregular use wins for overlapping spellings.
definition.specialized: Only regular inflections, including ordinary spelling adjustments and f/fe/ff-to-ves noun plurals. A regular form of an irregular verb is still regular.
definition.independentSensePolicy: Separate ESDB headword/lemma entries through size 70 qualify, including adjectives and entries with unknown part of speech. A participle or gerund form alone does not. Explicit reviewed exceptions preserve existing base targets outside this metadata cutoff.
definition.morphologyPolicy: Use documented relationships at all ESDB sizes; do not infer base words by stripping endings. Consider complete variant groups and base words outside playable lengths. Pronoun forms using ordinary plural endings are regular; other pronoun forms are irregular.

source.name: English Speller Database (ESDB)
source.modifications: Parsed lexical groups and inflection relationships to classify the American-only SCOWL 2020.12.07 target inventory. No upstream code executed; no ESDB words added to target or accepted vocabularies.
